title: This Whale Dove 9,816 Feet and Held Its Breath 3 Hours

scenes.text: One whale dove 9,816 feet down. That's nearly two miles.
It's a Cuvier's beaked whale, and it holds the record for any mammal.
It can stay down for over three and a half hours on a single breath.
Its heart slows down and it saves oxygen for only the vital organs.
Then it rests for just a few minutes at the surface and does it again.
It outdives every other mammal on Earth.
Nearly two miles down on one breath.

description:
A Cuvier's beaked whale dove 9,816 feet, nearly two miles, and another stayed down for 222 minutes.
No other mammal comes close.
How long can you hold your breath?
first_comment: How long can you hold your breath? Be honest.
